notes: Mags Oakum's Patient Ann from Kestrel Lock to the Wendmouth Stone Wharf (downriver, 1 game day), mw-e25.15. Mornings only (05:00 to 12:00) and only from the morning after the first night (time.day 2 or later): at night she will not run, 'not with whatever's singing up there' (bible 3.6). Sold through mags-patient-ann. Four crowns, as her dialogue always quoted.
name: Passage to the Wendmouth Stone Wharf
